The first-paint screen while the boot stages run: the product hero, a neutral indicator, consent for metered downloads, and the offline and blocked stops. It is the product's screen, so it carries the product ambient behind the hero and no Polaris Key mark.

<ComponentStates component="Boot" />

## Baselines

<KitBaselines component="Boot" />

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `boot` (a live line per stage, the consent question, then Ready or the stop and its fix).

    **Styled part.** `screens.boot_progress(kit, stage, frame)`, `screens.boot(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `boot_view(outcome)` → `BootView`; `BOOT_STAGE_COPY` maps each stage to its line in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
